gaps.lead: 'Shall I carry that for you?' he asked.
gaps.explanation: offer to do something: offered to carry it.

gaps.lead: Yesterday, I informed my boss in writing that I would be leaving the company.
gaps.hint: inform your employer in writing = hand in your ___
gaps.explanation: 'Hand in one's notice' means formally resign.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.

gaps.lead: He would rather not talk about the accident.
